name: Yuuenchi
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional amusement park: a notice about numbered tickets for a crowded coaster, a first day as a part-time staff member, a ticket-buying guide, a trial online fast-pass reservation system, training plans for new staff, a staffer teaching the fast-pass system to a newcomer, an essay on why the fast-pass system started, fast-pass sign-up rules, a priority-slot scheduling rule, and a one-year report on how it changed the park. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
